analyst_view.overall: Atletico Madrid (26th, 4 points) and Viking (25th, 4 points) sit one place apart in the clubs' first meeting, and Atletico, after losing to Liverpool and Bayern, need to win at home to keep any hope of the top eight. Atletico beat Getafe 3-0 on Sunday; Lookman and Cuti Romero are out and counted, Marc Pubill has recovered from his ankle sprain according to two Spanish reports, Hjulmand is back from his European ban, and one report says Sorloth was left out of the squad, with Kang-in Lee or Baena next to Julian Alvarez. Viking, three points behind Bodo/Glimt in the Norwegian title race after losing 3-2 at Tromso, miss Bjorshol, D'Agostino, Roseth and Baertelsen (counted), and an illness has hit the squad: left-back Kristoffer Haugen is out and top scorer Peter Christiansen is still a doubt, neither on the numbers' list. Belgian referee Erik Lambrechts (about 2.9 cards a game) is named and already counted.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.8 goals (2.6 Atletico, 1.2 Viking), with only small cuts for Lookman and Romero. Viking's illness is not on their list: Haugen is missing at left-back and Christiansen is doubtful, and Viking have already conceded 10 in four Champions League games, so their defence looks weaker than the numbers assume. Pubill being fit again and Sorloth possibly missing pull a little the other way, so I keep a small lean higher, to about 3.9.

corners.text: The numbers say 11.6 corners, 8.0 for Atletico, who should pin Viking back, with momentum already counted on both sides. Atletico's width comes from Giuliano Simeone, Llorente and Grimaldo whoever plays up front, and a makeshift Viking left side changes little to the total, so I stay at 11.6.

cards.text: The numbers say 2.9 cards, already taking about 16% off for Lambrechts' low card rate and both sides' calm recent runs. There is no rivalry, Viking play an open, passing game and nothing in the news points to a nastier match, so I stay at 2.9.

shots.text: The numbers say 30.9 shots (21.0 Atletico, 9.9 Viking), already lifted for Viking's busy recent shooting. Viking's illness could cut their shots a little while Atletico should dominate even more, which roughly cancels out, so I stay at 30.9.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.8 on target, 7.6 for Atletico. Julian Alvarez leads the line whether Sorloth or Kang-in Lee partners him, and Viking's threat depends on whether Christiansen shakes off his illness, so nothing clearly moves this; I stay at 10.8.
